ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A snake is an example of what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of trophic levels in a food chain; the left side is a terrestrial food chain, the right side is a marine food chain, and in the middle there are colored labels marking different trophic levels. The terrestrial food chain on the left, from bottom to top, is plants, insects, mice, snakes, eagles; the snake is located above the mouse and below the eagle. The horizontal position where the snake is located aligns with the middle purple label “Tertiary consumers”. Reasoning: Read the food chain from bottom to top according to the diagram, and match the row where the snake is located with the middle trophic level label; the snake belongs to “Tertiary consumers”.
